text: Program Description Training objectives: Aiming to nurture high-level applicative talents who adapts to the modern marketing needs, apprehend the theory of modern company management and entrepreneurship with excellent communicating and practical skills to work at a profitable or non-profitable institution. Main course: Management, Economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Financial Management, Human Resources Management, Marketing, Strategic for Entrepreneur, Entrepreneurship, Risk Management, E-commerce, Brand Management. Employment Orientation: Student has the capability to engage in economic analysis, planning, management and marketing at all kinds of companies, consulting firms, or government agencies after graduation, or start his own business or assist others to start up.
